adjudication.rationale: The new unauthenticated `GET /embed/best` route enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, embed_url: ...)` whenever `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` is nil (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The job calls `TopicRetriever#retrieve`, whose only rate limiting is a Redis throttle keyed by the full `@embed_url` for 60s (`retrieved:#{@embed_url}`), i.e., per-URL only (lib/topic_retriever.rb). An attacker can vary `embed_url` paths on the allowed host to enqueue many jobs and trigger many HTTP fetches (`TopicEmbed.import_remote` uses `open(url).read`) and topic/post creation (`TopicEmbed.import` creates via `PostCreator` with `skip_validations: true`). There is no per-IP, per-host, or global enqueue limit/deduplication shown in the diff; `ensure_embeddable` only checks `request.referer` host against `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, which can be spoofed and does not mitigate volume.
